applicableAreas: Overhead distribution line along southern property boundary; detention pond and biofiltration basins in northeast corner
findings.comment: Overhead electric line (OHE) shown on landscape plan along southern property boundary, with water quality features (sedimentation/filtration basins) in northeast corner. Required engineer-sealed profile or section plans demonstrating clearance compliance between overhead distribution conductors and water quality features are not provided. Applicant must provide engineer-prepared and sealed profile/section exhibits with dimensions showing 7.5-foot sky-to-ground minimum clearance maintained from overhead distribution primary, neutral, or secondary conductors to water quality features.

applicableAreas: 5' Electric Easement along southern property boundary
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows trees and sod proposed within or immediately adjacent to the 5' Electric Easement along the southern property boundary. No executed license agreement from Austin Energy Public Involvement is evidenced on the site plan or in attached documentation. Plans show landscaping within easement boundaries but do not indicate that agreement has been 'obtained from and filed with' Austin Energy. Applicant must obtain executed license agreement from Austin Energy Public Involvement permitting the landscaping and irrigation proposed within the electric easement, and evidence of filing must be documented on site plan before approval.

applicableAreas: 5' Electric Easement along southern property boundary
findings.comment: Landscape plan depicts trees, sod, and wooden privacy fence along the southern property boundary within the 5' Electric Easement area. While vegetation and fencing are shown, plans do not demonstrate or document that Austin Energy maintenance vehicles maintain 24/7 vehicular access through the easement for equipment and crew access. Site plan does not show drivable surfaces, turning radii, or clear access routes confirming unobstructed maintenance access. Applicant must provide updated plan demonstrating 24/7 vehicular access corridors and clearances through landscaped easement areas for Austin Energy equipment and maintenance operations.

applicableAreas: 5' Electric Easement along southern property boundary
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows wooden privacy fence (H-6) running along the entire southern property boundary within the 5' Electric Easement. Legend indicates fence is 'wooden' type, which may be removable under license agreement provisions. However, no Austin Energy coordination documentation is evidenced confirming (1) that the wooden fence is specifically designed as removable to permit crew and equipment access, (2) that a license agreement has been obtained permitting this fence installation, or (3) that Austin Energy has approved the fence design. Applicant must provide proof that the fence meets removable/wooden specification per UCM § 1.10.10.2 and confirmation from Austin Energy that access provisions are acceptable.

applicableAreas: 5' Electric Easement along southern property boundary and other easement areas
findings.comment: Erosion and sedimentation control plans (Sheets 5-7) do not provide sufficient detail to determine whether construction staging areas, spoils areas, temporary structures, equipment placement, or material stockpiles are located within electric easement boundaries. Plans do not explicitly demonstrate that 24-hour access to electric facilities will be maintained throughout construction. Applicant must clarify in construction sequencing notes that no construction staging, materials, equipment, or temporary structures will occupy electric easement areas, or if unavoidable, demonstrate how 24-hour Austin Energy access is maintained during construction.

applicableAreas: 5' Electric Easement along southern property boundary near pull box
findings.comment: Electrical plan (Sheet 21) shows an electrical pull box located on the southern property boundary within the 5' Electric Easement. Landscape plan (Sheet 31) shows trees and other landscaping features proposed along the southern boundary in proximity to this pull box location. No dimensions are provided specifying clearances from the pull box to proposed trees, grass, or other improvements. Applicant must provide updated landscape plan with dimension callouts confirming that all proposed structures, vegetation, and landscaping maintain minimum 8-foot clearance in all directions from the electrical pull box requiring personnel access per UCM § 1.10.10.2.
